note: Re-judged 2026-11-03 by an independent auditor who authored none of ee1025b381. RFC 4271 Section 5.1.4: "If a BGP speaker is configured to remove the MULTI_EXIT_DISC attribute from a route, then this removal MUST be done prior to determining the degree of preference of the route and prior to performing route selection (Decision Process phases 1 and 2)." The only change to test/plugin/med-removal-before-decision.ci is its header comment, which the previous verdict flagged as a nit: it named the deleted TestMEDRemovalMechanismIsConfigurable. It now names four live carriers, each read and found to assert what the header says: filter_modify TestHandleFilterUpdateMEDRemoveIsImportOnly (med remove on import, withheld on export), policychain TestExternalMEDRemove (one AttrModSuppress of code 4 on import, no op without a MED, a failed route on export), reactor TestLibraryMEDRemovalFollowsTheChainOrder (the later import member decides, three subtests) and TestLibraryMEDRemovalLeavesNoZeroLengthAttribute (no attribute 4, no zero-length attribute, ORIGIN survives). No option, input, expect or requirement-tag line moved, so the .ci still requires the Adj-RIB-In stored route to carry no MED with the exact ORIGIN, AS_PATH and COMMUNITIES survivors. The other carriers (TestHandleFilterUpdateMEDRemoveIsImportOnly, med-removal-configured.ci, med-removal-export-refused.ci) are unchanged. Verdict unchanged: enforced.
